From: Polymer Health Security <security@polymerhealth.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archer onboarding request & TLS cert chain

Hi Mina,

Thanks for agreeing to get Redwood onboarded to our Archer portal. We're kicking off the scoped assessment for Polymer Health and need a couple of items to finish the portal claim. Can you help with the following?

- Upload a PEM of the current public cert chain used by api.redwood-inference.com (full chain, not just leaf). We need this to validate TLS termination and intermediate trust.
- A consolidated manifest (CSV) listing the evidence artifacts for SIG/CAIQ mapping (names, filenames, document type, last updated).
- Confirm whether Redwood rotates the CA/KMS keys used to sign evidence (brief yes/no and cadence).

Portal info: https://archer-security.com/portal/claims/PH-4821
Requested by: Tue Apr 14 COB (we can be flexible by 48h if needed).

If you prefer, we can provide a temporary portal uploader account and a short S3 presign window for an automated bulk upload.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this claim is in the final review queue.

Regards,
Aisha Reynolds
Security Program Manager
Polymer Health

[Attachment: polymer-assessment-scope.pdf (PDF, 72KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding request & TLS cert chain

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- We can extract the full certificate chain and will provide a PEM. Attaching a preliminary CSR/PEM for your validation so you can confirm the chain you see matches our edge cert.
- We'll produce the manifest CSV with file-level metadata and CAIQ/SIG mapping columns. Ben (cc'd) will assemble the evidence artifacts.
- KMS/CA rotation: yes — we rotate signing keys quarterly; high-level cadence noted in the manifest under "key_rotation".

Two logistical questions:
1) Do you want the artifacts uploaded directly to Archer or would you rather we upload to a presigned S3 window and then share links?
2) If Archer requires a specific filename convention (claim-PH-####-artifact.ext) let us know and we'll adapt.

We'll aim to have the initial PEM + manifest to you by Mon Apr 13 EOD PT. If you provide a temporary uploader account, that will speed verification.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Onboarding – Redwood Inference

[Attachment: arbor_csr.pem (pem, 2.3KB) — preliminary CSR attached for chain verification]
